Sheet.EffectiveHint: With its effects and buffs. The box holds the base number.
Sheet.Name: Name
Sheet.ManaHint: Current mana / max mana. Max mana is enhanced Intelligence plus buffs.
Sheet.ShieldSlotHint: Click to spend this shield slot
Sheet.FillDamageDone: Filled damage for {count} skills and spells.

Stat.ActionsHint: Actions each round: 2, plus Extra Actions effects.
Stat.ShieldDrHint: Shield DR from your equipped shield. A Shield Block that Major Fails reduces it by 1 DR, a Critical Fail reduces it by 2; it breaks when it reaches 0 DR.
Stat.ShieldRepair: Repair your equipped shield: restore its DR and mend it

Health.Hint: Click a slot to set health there. Each slot's number is the damage it takes to lose it (CON mod plus bonuses).

Hotlist.Empty: Nothing on the hotlist. Use Configure to set it.
Hotlist.ConfigureHint: Open the hotlist slots; drag items onto them from the sheet's other tabs.
Hotlist.ConfigHint: Drag items, skills or spells from the character sheet onto a slot. Drag a filled slot onto another to swap them.
Hotlist.OwnedOnly: Only this crawler's own items can go on the hotlist.
Hotlist.NoHealing: No healing items, scrolls or spells on the hotlist.
Hotlist.UseHint: Pick the hotlist item to use.

Empty.Skills: No skills yet. Drag one in from a compendium.
Empty.Inherent: No inherent spells. Add an "Inherent Spell" rule to an effect, or set a spell's usage to Inherent.

Flavor.Label: Flavor text
Flavor.Placeholder: What people notice at a glance
Flavor.Hint: Shown when someone holds Shift while hovering the token. Mobs and NPCs without it show their description.

Item.BrokenHint: Broken gear does nothing until repaired: no effects, no DR, it can't be used or attacked with, and a shield can't be used to Shield Block. A successful Repair check (or the shield's repair button on the sheet) mends it.
Item.RankHint: Base rank; the arrow shows the rank after effects.
Item.IsUnarmedHint: Needs no weapon, so it gets its own row on the attacks table. Other attack skills only appear through a weapon that names them. Pugilism, Unarmed Combat and the other unarmed skills count already.
Item.SkillHint: Skill name, or blank for STR/DEX
Item.DamageTypesHint: Pick one or more. Damage of several types is split evenly between them (rounded down), and each part meets the target's resistances on its own.
Item.AreaHint: Hits an area. Targets with a halve-area-damage effect take half.
Item.HealingHint: Health slots restored. RANK and RANK_DIE (Core Rulebook p.176) use the current Rank.
Item.Name: Name

Effect.Title: Effects
Effect.ApplyHint: Not applied to the owner. Drag it onto a target's sheet or token to apply it.
Effect.ItemHint: Effects that apply to the owner are active while the item is held (weapons, equipment and tattoos must be equipped). Effects with a rank requirement switch on when the skill or spell reaches that rank.

Spell.NotFound: No spell with this name was found in the world or compendia.

Mob.CrawlerHint: A GM-run crawler on the mob sheet: it joins a party and stands with it on the boss battle splash.
Mob.StatBudgetHint: Every stat starts at 1 for mobs and 5 for bosses and deities. Mobs get 3 more points per level; bosses and deities get their tier's points per level.
Mob.DeityLevelHint: Feral gods are level 150; gods are level 250.
Mob.EliteHint: An Elite takes as many actions a round as there are crawlers in the party, like a boss. It shows as a normal mob on the minimap until the GM reveals it from its token (right-click the token).
Mob.OutsiderHint: Not a crawler and not one of the dungeon's residents, like hunters and tourists: purple on the minimap.
Mob.ActionsHint: Bosses, deities and Elites take as many actions a round as there are crawlers in the party (in combat, the crawlers in the encounter).

Npc.DropMob: Drop a Mob actor here to use it as this NPC's stat block.
Npc.ImportantHint: An important NPC: a star on the minimap instead of a dot.

Roll.StatHint: Roll a check. Shift-click to skip the dialog.
Roll.EvadeHint: Roll Evade. Shift-click to skip the dialog.
Roll.NoTargets: No targets. Target tokens before attacking to see hit or miss.

Damage.BlockHint: Shield Block: turn on after a successful Shield Block check. Halves the damage (from Rank 15, minus STR too).
Damage.BlockUnavailable: Shield Block can't stop area damage, or magic below Rank 5.

Combat.MobModeHint: Advantage adds 5 to the attack's Difficulty and Disadvantage takes 5 off. From effects uses the mob's own effects and debuffs.
Combat.FreeEvadeHint: Disadvantaged attack: each target's Evade is free. A crawler whose free Evade fails may spend an Action to Evade again.
Combat.EvadeAgainHint: Spend an Action to roll Evade again against this Disadvantaged attack.
Combat.NoMobAttacks: No mob with an attack is in this combat.
Combat.BlockHint: Roll Shield Block against the attack. A success still hits, but the damage is halved when applied.
Combat.CannotBlock: Shield Block needs the Shield Block skill and an equipped shield, and can't stop area damage (or magic below Rank 5).
Combat.ResolveHint: Roll damage for every target that was hit. Unanswered targets count as tanking.

Condition.Title: Conditions
Condition.DragHint: Drag onto a token to apply
Condition.NoTargets: Target one or more tokens first, or drag the condition onto a token.

Frames.Title: Crawlers
Frames.PlayersSettingHint: Show the names of each crawler's players beside its name in the crawler frames.
Frames.SettingHint: Show the party's Health and Mana frames beside the scene list.
Frames.DragHealth: Drag to set Health in 10% steps (arrow keys work too)
Frames.DragHint: Drag to move; double-click to put it back
Frames.StackHint: Click: add a stack · Right-click: remove a stack · Shift-click: remove all

Marks.Title: Kills
Marks.Setting: Skulls and stars in crawler frames
Marks.SettingHint: Show the skulls (crawlers and leaderboard crawlers killed) and stars (bosses killed, coloured by tier) beside each crawler's name in the crawler frames. Count them in the Kills window on the crawler sheet.

BossBar.SettingHint: Show a health bar across the top of the screen for each boss in the combat.
BossBar.DragHint: Drag to move, drag the corner to resize; double-click to put it back

SkillCreator.Title: Skill Creator
SkillCreator.SettingHint: A step-by-step window for making homebrew skills, following the Homebrew Skill Flow Chart by diffendice & Dungeon Anarchists, plus the "Make skill" button on drawn Earth hobbies.
SkillCreator.Off: The Skill Creator is turned off in the system settings.
SkillCreator.NoPermission: Only the GM can add skills to the world; a player can make one for a crawler they own.
SkillCreator.Hint: Answer the chart's questions from the top. The balance check at the bottom updates as you go.
SkillCreator.Name: Skill name
SkillCreator.RollHobbyHint: Name it after a random Earth hobby from the hobby tables.

Step.Want: What do you want to do?

SkillCreator.Compare: Compare first, maybe reflavor one of these:
SkillCreator.CompareNone: No skills for this purpose were found in the world or compendiums.
SkillCreator.CompareFight: Compare with the ranged, melee and unarmed weapon skills.
SkillCreator.LimitationsHint: What circumstances or items does it need?
SkillCreator.UpgradeHint: Blank: an attack adds one more die

Balance.Ok: Nothing stands out. Compare it with a similar core skill before it goes into play.
Balance.BigDie: A d10 or d12 attack with no cooldown hits harder than most core weapon skills.
Balance.PassiveAttack: Passive attack skills are rare; make sure it can't stack damage every turn.
Balance.UnarmedRanged: An unarmed ranged attack is unusual: say how it reaches.
Balance.NoTarget: Pick who the skill works on.
Balance.Upgrades: Core skills get something at Rank 5, 10 and 15.
Balance.Unlimited: Used against enemies with no cooldown or limitation, it may be worth giving it one.

SkillCreator.Credit: Based on the Homebrew Skill Flow Chart by diffendice & Dungeon Anarchists: {link}.
SkillCreator.HobbyNote: Earth hobby skill ({hobby}), made with the Skill Creator.

Rewards.SettingHint: Boxes whose type and tier the community d100 reward-box tables cover roll on those tables (the row can hand off to the item generator); its spell lists set which spells each box can hold, and its "100 random items" widen what the generator makes. Off: every box uses the generator. Reloads the world.
Rewards.UniqueHint: GM: make something unique and customized for this crawler.
Rewards.PickSpell: GM: no matching scroll or tome is in the database. Pick a spell from: {spells}.

Leaderboard.Title: Leaderboard & Population
Leaderboard.SettingHint: The Top Ten leaderboard the GM keeps (shown to players when the GM chooses) and the crawlers-remaining count announced at floor transitions.
Leaderboard.Off: The leaderboard tools are turned off in the system settings.
Leaderboard.Hidden: The GM hasn't shown the leaderboard yet.
Leaderboard.BoardHint: Anyone can be on it: type names, add crawlers from the world, or start from one of the books' leaderboards and change it however you like.
Leaderboard.Label: Heading
Leaderboard.ReplaceConfirm: Replace the current leaderboard with this one?
Leaderboard.Full: The leaderboard already has ten crawlers.
Leaderboard.Source: Book leaderboards as transcribed on the Dungeon Crawler Carl wiki (fandom, CC-BY-SA).
Leaderboard.PopulationHint: Crawlers alive as each floor opens. When the party first reaches a floor with a count, it is announced in chat. The book counts come from the community crawler population estimator (canon where the books give a number, estimated between).
Leaderboard.AutoAnnounce: Announce automatically when the party reaches a new floor
Leaderboard.NoCount: No crawler count is set for floor {floor}.

Encounter.Title: Encounter Tuner
Encounter.Hint: How many mobs to use for a fight. Headcount matters most: every extra mob is another attack each round.
Encounter.Tip1: Shift it for the party's tactics and gear, the terrain, the objective and how worn down they are.
Encounter.Tip2: Tune it during the fight: reinforcements, mobs that flee, rivals, distractions.
Encounter.Tip3: Mobs can steal gear or chase a goal instead of finishing off a downed crawler.
Encounter.Off: The Encounter Tuner is turned off in the CrawlSpace settings.
Encounter.SettingHint: The GM's Encounter Tuner (token controls): how many mobs to use by threat and party size. CrawlSpace Atlas also uses it to size the mob groups Place Mobs puts in each room.

BossBattle.Title: Boss Battle
BossBattle.Dismiss: Click or press Escape to close
BossBattle.DismissAll: Click or press Escape to close it for everyone
BossBattle.NoEnemies: No enemies: select the boss's tokens, or start a combat with hostile combatants.
BossBattle.NoCrawlers: There are no crawlers in the party.
BossBattle.SoundHint: The sound bite every client plays when the GM starts a boss battle. Leave blank for the one that comes with CrawlSpace.
BossBattle.Auto: Boss battle when a boss encounter starts
BossBattle.AutoHint: Show the boss battle splash to everyone when the GM starts a combat with a visible boss in it. The Start a boss battle button works either way.
BossBattle.SoundBitesHint: Play CrawlSpace sound bites, such as the boss battle's, on this computer.

Upkeep.Title: Upkeep: {name}
Upkeep.Hint: Rests restore health and mana and clear some debuffs. Advancement rolls d20 for each marked skill and spell.
Upkeep.PointsWaiting: {points} stat points waiting to be assigned.
Upkeep.FloorThree: Stat points can be assigned from floor 3.
Upkeep.GMRequired: The GM has not enabled player upkeep.
Upkeep.NoTime: Player upkeep changes recovery and progress without advancing time.
Upkeep.PlayerSetting: Allow player upkeep without time skips
Upkeep.PlayerSettingHint: Players may run upkeep for crawlers they own. Only the GM can advance the clock.
Upkeep.UntrainedHint: Choose one marked Rank 0 skill to learn at Rank 1. All other untrained skills are removed, as in CrawlSpace.
Upkeep.Learned: Learned {name} at Rank 1; other untrained skills removed.
Upkeep.Requested: Your upkeep request went to the GM.
Upkeep.RequestHint: Your choice goes to the GM as a request; the GM approves it before it happens.
Upkeep.AutomationSettingHint: Upkeep buttons apply their changes on their own: rests heal and advance the clock, advancement rolls ranks, Level Up raises the level. Turn this off and the GM is asked each time whether to automate it; if not, it's only noted in chat.
Upkeep.AutomateAsk: Automate it? Without automation nothing changes and it's only noted in chat.
Upkeep.Manual: Not automated: apply any changes by hand.
Upkeep.ManualHint: Your choice goes to the GM, who decides whether to automate it.

Import.CharacterHint: Import a CrawlSpace character (.json), account export (.json or .zip) or party backup (.zip)

AutoAdvance.Name: Auto-advance combat phases
AutoAdvance.Hint: Move to the next phase as soon as everyone on the acting side is done.

Homebrew.Name: Homebrew compendiums
Homebrew.Hint: Show the system's Homebrew Skills, Spells and Items compendiums. Turn this off to remove them from the world (their entries already on actors stay). Reloads the world.

CraftApproval.Name: Crafting approval
CraftApproval.Hint: Whether crafting from a recipe needs the GM's OK. Experiments always go to the GM.
CraftApproval.mixed: Automatic for some items (see the rules), the GM approves the rest

CraftRules.Name: Auto-approved crafts
CraftRules.Label: Edit rules
CraftRules.Hint: The item types, rarities and tags that skip the GM in “some automatic” mode.

CraftCategories.Name: Extra crafting categories
CraftCategories.Hint: Comma-separated names added to Alchemy, Arcanist, Armorer, Engineering, Metalworking, Sapper's, Writing, Tattoo and Mundane.

PersonalSpaces.Name: Personal Spaces (homebrew)
PersonalSpaces.Hint: Personal Space actors, their upgrades and crafting tables, the Personal Space compendiums, and the rest, grinding and crafting bonuses a crawler gets while in their space. Off: the compendiums are hidden, the types leave the Create dialogs and nothing changes rests or crafting. Existing spaces are kept.

Warn.NeedGM: A GM must be connected to do that.
Warn.MacroOwned: That macro needs an item owned by an actor.
Warn.MacroScript: Your role can't make script macros. The GM can allow it under Configure Permissions → Use Script Macros.
Warn.Tainted: {name} has The Taint and can't be healed.
Warn.Broken: {name} is broken. Repair it before using it.
Warn.SpellNotFound: Could not find a spell named {name}.
Warn.RowGone: That attack or action is no longer on the sheet.
Warn.NoBuildContent: No compendium has any {kind} entries yet.

Actions.ConfigureHint: Open the actions popup; drag items, skills, spells, abilities or pack actions onto it.
Actions.ConfigHint: Drag items, skills, spells or abilities from the character sheet, or actions from the Actions packs (magnifier), onto a table. Drag a row onto the other table to move it.
Actions.OwnedOnly: Drop this crawler's own items, or actions from the Actions packs.
Actions.MoveCard: Move {move} ft + Step {step} ft = up to {total} ft.
Actions.KindHint: Which actions table this shows in when it is on the hotlist. Automatic: both when its text mentions Interrupt, else Actions.
Actions.SkillsHint: Skills the check uses, comma separated. If the crawler has exactly one of them it is rolled; otherwise they pick.

Craft.Title: Crafting
Craft.OpenHint: Open the crafting window: recipes, tables, recipe books and experiments.
Craft.ApprovalHint: How crafts are approved in this world. The GM sets it in the system settings.
Craft.StudyHint: Learn the recipes in this book
Craft.AllLearned: You know every recipe in this book
Craft.GmOnlyHint: Players can't see this recipe until it unlocks.
Craft.PickRecipe: Pick a recipe to see what it needs.

Unlock.learned: learned from a book or the GM

Method.quick: Mix or infuse (1 minute per level)

Craft.BenchHint: Drag materials and items from your inventory, and skills or spells you use, onto the bench.
Craft.DesiredHint: Drop the item you want here, or describe it.
Craft.CancelHint: Take it back: the materials are free again
Craft.BenchOwnItems: Only items from this crawler's inventory can go on the bench.
Craft.BenchNotPhysical: That can't be used up in crafting.
Craft.NotReady: Something this recipe needs is missing.
Craft.Requested: Sent to the GM for approval.
Craft.CritFail: Critical Fail: the item breaks. The GM may allow a Repair or salvage.
Craft.NoSalvageMix: A failed mix can't be salvaged.
Craft.RulesHint: In “Some automatic” mode, crafts of these item types, rarities or tags go through on their own. Every other craft waits for the GM. A recipe can also choose for itself.
Craft.ExperimentSent: Your experiment went to the GM.
Craft.EditedHint: Edit it in its sheet, then decide.
Craft.DropOtherHint: Drop the item they get instead.
Craft.SaveRecipe: Save as a recipe they know
Craft.DropOther: Drop the item to give first.
Craft.NoRecipesHere: No recipes make this item yet. Add one so crawlers can craft it.
Craft.DeleteRecipeAsk: Delete this recipe? Crawlers who learned it lose it.
Craft.AddJunkHint: Add the Misc. Junk this size needs
Craft.MinutesHint: Leave blank to use the rules' time.
Craft.BatchHint: Extra copies take a minute per bonus level each, with all the ingredients on hand.
Craft.AdvantageHint: Roll the check with Advantage (an infusion).
Craft.TagHint: Any material with this tag counts
Craft.DropIngredients: Drop materials or items used up in crafting.
Craft.DropRequires: Drop skills, spells, tables or tools it needs.
Craft.HintPlaceholder: Rumor has it a troll's blood is the key…
Craft.DropUnlock: Drop an item, skill or table, or add a condition.
Craft.TeachesHint: A crawler who owns this item can study it to learn these recipes.
Craft.DropTeaches: Drop items whose recipes this book teaches.
Craft.LiquidHint: Liquids are never salvaged from a failed craft.
Craft.UpgradesHint: Table add-ons, comma separated. Recipes can require them.
Craft.AutoLevelHint: Gains a tier each time its owner reaches a new floor (to tier 10).
Craft.TagsHint: Comma separated. Recipes can ask for any item with a tag, and the approval rules can match tags.
Craft.NoCrafter: No crawler to craft with. Select a token or assign a character.

Ids.Title: Identifiers
Ids.UuidHint: Unique to this document in this world. Use it in @UUID links and macros.
Ids.SourceIdHint: The compendium entry this was created from, if any.
Ids.CrawlSpaceHint: The CrawlSpace database row this was imported from (database:id).

RowConfig.DamageHint: Leave blank to use the weapon or skill damage.

Rules.Title: Rules
Rules.DropWrongType: Drop a skill or spell of the right kind here.

Time.Title: Time & Timers
Time.ClockHint: 30-hour days. Exploration runs in real time when enabled. Foundry pause stops the clock; combat advances 10 seconds per round.
Time.Label: Name
Time.SkipHint: Advance time once for everyone. Select crawlers for recovery or safe-room advancement. Short, long, and full rests use fixed lengths; other activities use the hours below. Grinding here advances time only.
Time.GMOnly: The GM advances shared time. Ask the GM to include your crawler in Time & Timers.
Time.InvalidDuration: Enter a valid duration or whole number of hours.
Time.Busy: A time skip is already in progress.
Time.InCombat: End combat before resting or skipping hours. Advance combat rounds in the tracker.
Time.SelectActors: Select the crawlers participating in this activity.

Event.healed: Heal at least one health slot

Time.FloorPrompt: Set the remaining time before this floor collapses. The Days field uses the day length in the system settings.
Time.OverflowHint: Overflow is converted automatically: 90 minutes becomes 1 hour 30 minutes, and extra hours roll over into days.

DayLength.Name: Day length
DayLength.Hint: How many hours a day shows as on timers, cooldowns and time entry. Display only: nothing lasts longer or shorter, and "1 day" in rules text is still a 30-hour dungeon day. With 24-hour days, 30 hours reads as 1 day 6 hours.

Grinding.Title: Grinding
Grinding.Hint: The first five hours are productive. Additional hours require Endurance checks; failures add Fatigued. Assign the productive hours to skills and spells, then resolve daily advancement checks.
Grinding.NewDay: Start a new grinding day (keep banked progress)
Grinding.DayError: {name} would exceed 30 grinding hours today. Start a new grinding day first.
Grinding.EnduranceError: Add Endurance to {name} before overtime grinding.
Grinding.AllocateError: Assign exactly {hours} whole hours, within the displayed limits.
Grinding.LevelResult: Gained {gained} levels; now Level {level}. Stat points are banked.
Grinding.Summary: {hours} actual hours; {productive} productive hours today; {level} hours banked toward the next level.
Grinding.Changed: Grinding progress changed while this session was open. Reopen upkeep before confirming.

Awards.Title: Crawler Awards
Awards.NumberHint: Enter a total, or use +5 / -2 to adjust the current value. Leave blank to keep it.
Awards.DropAchievement: Or drop an achievement from a compendium here.
Awards.name: Achievement name
Awards.Link: Link the reward to the awarded loot box
Awards.PreparedHint: Choose a loot box with prepared contents, or drop one here.
Awards.NamedHint: The box's contents are rolled for its tier and type when it is opened.
Awards.GenerateFirst: Generate the box first, or choose another loot box source.
Awards.NotPrepared: {name} has no prepared contents. Use Prepare contents on its sheet first.
Awards.GoldNotAllowed: {gold} Gold can't be awarded on this crawler's floor. Award the box without the Gold?
Awards.UndoHint: Remove this award's items and restore AI Favor and Popularity
Awards.UndoOpened: This loot box was opened or removed, so the award can no longer be undone.
Awards.InvalidNumber: Enter a number or a modifier such as +5 or -2.
Awards.InvalidQuantity: Enter a loot box name and a whole quantity from 1 to 9999.

Loot.FloorSetting: Floor for X values and Gold
Loot.EarthHint: One Earth Hobby Potion. No ordinary Silver generation or Gold.
Loot.DropItems: Drop items from a compendium or the sidebar to add them.
Loot.SealedHint: Items and Gold stay sealed until the box is opened.
Loot.PreparedHint: These exact contents are awarded later; nothing is rerolled.
Loot.RollsOnOpen: Nothing prepared: the contents roll for the box's tier and type when it is opened.
Loot.OpenConfirm: Open {quantity} × {name} now? Boxes usually open during Safe Room upkeep.
Loot.NoPending: No loot boxes waiting to open

Minion.Label: Minion
Minion.Locked: A raised minion can be moved and rolled for, but only the GM can change it.
Minion.NoToken: {name} has no token on a scene to raise.
Minion.Raised: {name} rises as {caster}'s minion with {health} of {max} Health slots.

Ended.died: {name} dies again; the minion is gone.
Ended.ended: The condition holding {name} ends; it falls dead.

Companion.Title: Pets, Mounts & Minions
Companion.NoMaster: Follows no crawler. Drop a crawler here to link one.
Companion.DropHint: Drop a pet, mount or minion actor here, or make one.

Race.Title: Race & Chase
Race.QuarryHint: The quarry's set result this leg: 10 + the Stat Mod the leg's Skill uses + Floor + Move ÷ 10.
Race.RaceHint: Each leg, everyone rolls the leg's Skill plus Move ÷ 10. The highest result places 1st (higher Move breaks ties). The lowest placement total wins; a tie goes to the better last leg.
Race.ChaseHint: Each leg, chasers roll the leg's Skill plus Move ÷ 10 against the quarry's result. Amazing Success or better +2 Ground, Success +1, Near Miss 0, Fail -1, Major Fail -2, Critical Fail out. 4 Ground catches the quarry early, -4 loses it; after the last leg, any lead catches it.
Race.MoveModHint: Move, and the Move Rate Modifier (Move ÷ 10, rounded down) added to every leg.
Race.NpcHint: NPCs and Mobs don't roll: each leg they take 10 + the chosen Stat Mod + Floor + Move ÷ 10.
Race.Empty: Select tokens on the canvas and add them.

Vehicle.RamHint: Target what to ram. The vehicle's crawler rolls Driving against its Evade.
Vehicle.RamRecoil: The rammer takes half the damage and halves its Move, or the full damage and drops to 0 Move against a bigger target. Occupants take half of what their vehicle takes, less their own DR and the vehicle's ({dr}).
Vehicle.NoDriver: This vehicle follows no crawler, so nobody is driving it. Drop a crawler on it first.
Vehicle.ExplodesHint: Fire damage to everyone inside. The vehicle's DR doesn't protect them.
Vehicle.SampleHint: Sets this vehicle's Move, size, DR and occupancy.

Builder.Title: Character Builder
Builder.Name: Crawler name
Builder.NumberHint: The book suggests 500,000–12,900,000. Your GM may assign another number.
Builder.BackgroundHint: Choose one background per stage, then two different skills from each. Skills cannot repeat across backgrounds. Animal crawlers require your GM's agreement.
Builder.CombatIntro: You receive {attack} at Rank 3. Choose one additional combat option at Rank 3.
Builder.EffectHint: Also grants the {effect} damage-effect skill at Rank 3 and the Unarmed Combat achievement with a Bronze Weapon Box reward.
Builder.SpellHint: Requires INT 4 or higher. Includes five Standard Mana Potions and adds the spell and potions to the hotlist.
Builder.MatchHint: Matching skills, spells and weapons copy their compendium properties. A missing match creates an entry with only its name and starting rank.
Builder.StatHint: Roll all five stats or each stat on its own; you may reroll any stat. Every roll is posted to chat. Only unenhanced scores are set; the sheet works out the rest.
Builder.RollMismatch: {stat} does not match your latest stat roll in chat. Roll it again.
Builder.WeaponAdded: Your starting weapon will be added: {name}.
Builder.GearHint: Useful and weird items are created exactly as named, with blank properties. Starting clothing and weapons use a matching compendium entry when there is one.
Builder.Derived: Evade modifier +{evade}. Health: full (10 slots), {perSlot} per slot. Mana {mana}. Base Move 20 feet, Step 10 feet. Skill and equipment modifiers apply on the sheet.
Builder.StoryDeferred: Deferred; fill this out on the sheet later.
Builder.SentToGM: Your crawler has gone to the GM to be created.
Builder.NoUser: That user is no longer in this world.

Build.Capped: Detriments total {earned} points; only 5 can raise this build's budget.
Build.PoolHint: Races get 25 points and classes 30, plus up to 5 from detriments. Unspent points are lost. A build with rule checks can still be saved for the GM to review.
Build.StatHint: Each +1 costs a point; every 2 points of stat penalties earn 1 back. DR costs 2 points per +1, up to +3. Stat, skill, spell and DR bonuses go on this item's Build effect automatically.
Build.AllSkillHint: Each −1 to every skill under a stat earns 1 point.

Hint.skillBonuses: Standard and passive ranks cost 2 points each; unusual or racial skill ranks cost 4. Drop skills here to link them.
Hint.spellBonuses: Each rank costs 2 points. A class can grant at most 5 passive ranks across its skills and spells. Drop spells here to link them.
Hint.skillDetriments: A penalty must apply to an existing skill and can't exceed its current rank. Every 2 points of penalties earn 1 point. Drop skills here to link them.
Hint.benefits: Pick a template, then describe the target and conditions. Agree custom tiers with the GM. Cosmetic traits are free.
Hint.detriments: A build gains at most 5 extra points from detriments.

Build.DropSkill: Drop a skill here, or add one by hand.
Build.DropSpell: Drop a spell here, or add one by hand.
Build.WrongDrop: Only a {type} can go in this list.
Build.AlienHint: Alien races can earn popularity and can't choose Earth classes.
Build.EarthHint: Earth races can choose Earth classes and get a Silver Earth Box with a Hobby Potion granting 3 skill ranks.
Build.BackgroundSkillsHint: Crawlers taking this background pick two of these skills in the character builder.
Build.DropOne: Drop a {kinds} here to link it.

Mechanic.rankCap: Linked skills can reach rank 20 (from floor 7).
Mechanic.allRankCaps: All skills can reach rank 20 (from floor 7).
Mechanic.skillBonus: Each linked skill gets +1 rank per count.
Mechanic.resistance: The crawler resists the linked damage types.
Mechanic.immunity: The crawler is immune to the linked damage types and conditions.
Mechanic.vulnerability: The crawler is vulnerable to the linked damage types.
Mechanic.advanceBonus: +1 per count on end-of-floor advancement checks for linked skills.
Mechanic.advanceAdvantage: Advantage on advancement checks for the linked skill.
Mechanic.advancePenalty: −1 per count on advancement checks for the linked skill once it is rank 5 or higher.

Build.Replace: Replace {old} with {new}? The abilities that came with {old} are removed.
Build.Added: {name} added with {count} abilities and {skills} new skills and spells.
Build.ChooseBackgroundSkills: Choose {count} of this background's skills. They start at Rank {rank}.
Build.Browse: Browse the compendium (drag one onto the sheet)

Area.Title: Area
Area.Distance: Distance (ft): radius, length or cone reach
Area.Width: Width (ft): rectangle depth or line width

Calibrate.Title: Map grid calibration
Calibrate.Saved: Grid calibrated: the map was scaled and shifted to match.
Calibrate.ViewFirst: View the scene first to calibrate its grid.
Calibrate.SquareOnly: Grid calibration works on square grids.
Calibrate.Inspect:
Inspect the map
Zoom to a corner or the center to check alignment.
Calibrate.Help1: Click a grid intersection printed on your map to place the anchor. Click elsewhere to relocate it, or click and drag to move it.
Calibrate.Help2: Set the distance per square, then click a grid intersection three squares horizontally from the anchor. Click or drag to refine the point.
Calibrate.Help3: Click a grid intersection three squares vertically from the anchor. Click or drag to refine the point.
Calibrate.Help4: Check distant corners. Adjust only the grid spacing around your anchor. Hold + or − for continuous micro adjustments, or drag a preview line; the map stays still until you click Done.
Calibrate.InvalidMeasure: Enter a valid distance and unit.
Calibrate.StatusHorizontal: Choose the horizontal point three squares from the anchor.
Calibrate.StatusVertical: Choose the vertical point three squares from the anchor.
Calibrate.StatusCorners: Inspect all four corners before saving.
Calibrate.KeysPoint: Arrow keys: nudge measurement point · Shift: ×10
Calibrate.KeysScale: Arrow keys: adjust X/Y scale · Shift: ×10
Calibrate.KeysPan: Right-drag: pan · Wheel: zoom · Esc: cancel
